thesis: Manny Friedman describes Economic Opportunity Zones as a bipartisan government initiative designed to reallocate capital from underinvested areas of the United States to equalize economic disparities. He explains that the mechanism involves deferring capital gains for investors who commit to holding investments in these zones for ten years, with the goal of unlocking trillions of dollars in unrealized capital gains to fund startups and businesses.
